# Gloves.com

> > Gloves.com is a wholesale supplier of disposable and industrial gloves, offering nitrile, latex, and vinyl options for medical, food service, and industrial applications.

The site specializes in bulk purchasing of exam-grade and work gloves from brands like Shamrock, MCR Safety, HyFlex, and Ansell. Products range from 4-mil disposable nitrile gloves to heavy-duty cut-resistant and chemical-protective work gloves, with options for powder-free, medical-grade, and industry-specific applications.
